summary: Reports on a 2014 London workshop about domain name collisions, which happen when a name used privately collides with one that later appears in the public DNS. It summarizes the discussion of causes and possible mitigations. It is an informational report, not a protocol.

eli5.summary: Imagine two kids in different towns both named their pet Max, and then the towns merge. This report is a meeting where experts talked about what goes wrong when names clash and how to avoid it.
